scope: Prepared common LeakDB comparison only; individual paper recipes require separate verified configs

classification_dataset.name: LeakDB Hanoi_CMH example benchmark
classification_dataset.label: binary leak presence from each scenario Labels.csv

paper_tracks.exact_dataset_anchor: Vrachimis et al. 2018, LeakDB benchmark, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.1313116
paper_tracks.ltown_exact_reproduction_status: blocked: reference uses separate generated leak-free and single-leak pressure scenarios

common_classification_comparison.target: current binary leak presence at the final history timestamp

validation.paper_split_rule: Run the source paper's documented train/test or train/validation split once before project CV; never replace it with CV
validation.paper_split_unknown_policy: Mark undocumented ratios/scenario assignments as unverified and do not invent them
validation.mandatory_additional_cv: 10-fold cross-validation on each paper's training/development portion
validation.fold_training_support: all 10 folds have both classes and sufficient minority rows
validation.fold_assessment_note: 4 held-out scenarios have both classes; aggregate out-of-fold metrics use all 10, while class-dependent per-fold metrics are undefined for 6 no-leak scenarios
validation.test_event_note: report new events separately from leaks continuing across 2017-10-01

demand_forecasting_track.smote: not applicable to continuous demand targets

training_gate.scope: Common-dataset training class support only; not certification of paper reproduction or complete leakage audit
training_gate.next_step: Follow README Phase 1: verify paper datasets, splits and architectures and establish an evidenced research gap
